observation_summary: The peephole constant folding pass incorrectly attempted to fold array index operations even when they were used as assignment targets, leading to an index out of bounds error.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves adding a guard clause `if (isAssignmentTarget(n)) { return n; }` to prevent the folding logic from executing when the node is an assignment target. This is a classic missing guard/validation check, which falls under the 'Checking' category.
evidence_used: The fix adds a conditional check `if (isAssignmentTarget(n))` to return early.
The bug report states the pass is trying to fold array literals as property lookups when they are actually assignment targets.
The error is an 'INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS_ERROR', indicating an invalid operation was attempted on an array structure.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the logic was flawed, the fix is specifically the addition of a guard condition to prevent the execution of the existing algorithm in an invalid context, rather than a rewrite of the algorithm itself.
